task.description:
Step PR-12 and the sign-off for REQ-057. Two parts.
Part 1 (the readers, condition (g) of LANG061, section 18 PR-12 of docs/design/REQ-057-picker-page.md): the translation of the 23 page keys into kk and en was checked by fresh agents without code and documents in two rounds; the results (give them to the reader of your handoff as stated here, they are facts from this run): Kazakh, round 1: 23 pairs, 21 "yes", 2 fixed, round 2: all "yes"; English, round 1: 22 "yes", 1 fixed, round 2: "yes". One remaining doubt for a native Kazakh speaker: the key progress_label ("{total} ішінен {current}" instead of the current "Сұрақ {current} / {total}"); five lines of the demo tenants (105, 121, 139, 141, 160 of the kk tenant file) also remain for a native speaker; the owner said a native review is not needed now (decisions/0072). The reader files are outside the project; do not read them, do not invent. Read the final values of the 23 keys in tools/src/picker/public/texts.js and judge as a business reader: are they understandable to a small-business visitor in each language; list remarks as such. Do NOT change any file except the ones in your write-set.
Part 2 (sign-off): read docs/uat/REQ-057-RUN.md and the result of handoffs/PAGE057-20261021-01/step-26-uat-runner.json. For each of the 11 criteria of REQ-057 in docs/requirements.yaml say which evidence covers it (test ids or acceptance steps PR-n), and give your sign-off verdict (SIGNED or NOT SIGNED with reasons). Look at 6 snapshots of your choice (full paths in the UAT run file or under the output folder named in the handoff of step 26) and say what you see as the visitor: is it clear what to do, where am I, can I go back, what happens at the end (the end is a temporary screen until REQ-058: say so honestly). Write your sign-off to docs/uat/REQ-057-SIGNOFF.md (English; no machine paths, no other projects' names) and into your handoff. Honest limits: the temporary result screen; the page was never shown to a real visitor; Kazakh not reviewed by a native speaker; follow-up list items go in as remarks.

result.summary: SIGNED.
